before: The paper ship is made from a spoon,
I put it in the window to rhyme with the moon.
after: The paper ship goes drifting down the drain,
I watch it catch against the grating in the rain.
cases.teaches: Meaning and physical plausibility outrank end-rhyme perfection.
cases.use: study fault and revised mechanics; compose independent output

before: The lantern is shining across the street,
